snippet.title: PSX Longplay [568] Gundam Battle Assault 2
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by: Tsunao

"First battle! Attack the enemy mobile suit!"
[GIANT MECHA!] fightin' game by Bandai and Natsume.

Just big ol' robots beating up each other. NO PLOT!

Plays pretty much like the first one...I think. You have multiple life bars, a thrust/power/whatever gauge, and can use 3 special moves.

This longplay decides to play through Street Mode with all 8 robots, some which needs unlocking, on Hard difficulty! Raw super moves, ammo spamming, and special attack spamming are a-plenty! There are some timeouts because AI is a bitch (and Devil Gundam is ass with Maxter).
"Wealth and glory to the winner!" -victory pose-

Y'know...the only reason I am playing this is because of the music. =P The "next target" and victory music are my fav. -
Disclaimer: Most videos by World of Longplays use SaveStates!
